1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan sebagai Peraturan-Peraturan

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2026.

Bentuk aku janji

2. Bentuk aku janji yang ditetapkan bagi maksud subseksyen 36(1) Akta adalah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

ONLINE SAFETY ACT 2025

ONLINE SAFETY (FORM OF UNDERTAKING) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 81(2)(h) of the Online Safety Act 2025

[Act 866], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Online Safety (Form of

Undertaking) Regulations 2025.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2026.

Form of undertaking

2. The prescribed form of undertaking for the purposes of subsection 36(1)

of the Act is as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Regulation 2]
